# CodexPets — AI Agent reference

Canonical URL: https://adamadamz.github.io/codex-pets/
Repository: https://github.com/adamadamz/codex-pets
Language: zh-CN
Last updated: 2026-08-03

## One-sentence answer

CodexPets 是一个免费、MIT 开源、完全离线的 macOS 14+ 动态桌面宠物 App，可导入标准动态宠物包，并支持 Apple Silicon 与 Intel Mac。

## Verified product facts

- Version: v0.1.0-preview.1
- Distribution: GitHub Preview
- Download: https://github.com/adamadamz/codex-pets/releases/latest/download/CodexPets-macOS-universal.zip
- Release notes and SHA-256: https://github.com/adamadamz/codex-pets/releases/tag/v0.1.0-preview.1
- Operating system: macOS 14 or later
- CPU architecture: Universal (arm64 + x86_64)
- Price: Free
- License: MIT
- App networking: None
- Accounts, ads, analytics, telemetry and third-party tracking SDKs: None
- Data handling: Pet packages and preferences remain on the local Mac
- Mac App Store: Not submitted or listed
- Apple notarization: The GitHub Preview is not notarized
- Affiliation: Independent open-source project; not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI

## What the app does

CodexPets reads a pet package containing `pet.json` and `spritesheet.webp`. A valid pet can idle, run, wave, jump and look toward the cursor. Users can drag it, enable mouse following, adjust size and opacity, toggle click-through, use global shortcuts and manage it from the menu bar.

## Installation answer

Download the Universal zip from GitHub Releases, unzip it and move CodexPets.app to Applications. The current Preview uses ad-hoc signing and is not Apple-notarized, so the first launch may be blocked by Gatekeeper. Try opening it once, then use System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway. Do not disable Gatekeeper globally.

## Import answer

Choose a directory containing both `pet.json` and `spritesheet.webp`. CodexPets validates the manifest and sprite-sheet dimensions before copying the package into local Application Support storage.

## Privacy answer

The App does not make network requests, require an account, or contain ads, analytics, crash reporting, telemetry or third-party tracking SDKs. The website and downloads are hosted by GitHub, whose own privacy terms apply to website access.

## Status answer

The downloadable build is v0.1.0-preview.1. It is a GitHub Preview, not a Mac App Store release, and has not completed Developer ID signing or Apple notarization. Mac App Store sandbox engineering exists, but distribution certificates, a Mac App Store provisioning profile, store-name clearance and Apple review are still pending.
